meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码库交给多名漏洞猎手和验证工程师并行审查,找出真正可利用的缺陷并定级。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布前想确认代码里没有被忽视的可利用漏洞。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to confirm exploitable flaws before shipping.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会拉起 3 名漏洞猎手和 2 名 PoC 工程师并行审计代码库:梳理入口与信任边界、验证真实可利用性、按 CWE 分类根因,最后给出 PASS、PASS WITH FINDINGS 或 BLOCK 的结论报告。
howto.when: 当你要求安全审查、漏洞审计、可利用性审计等,或输入 /security-research 时触发;需已启用 team-mode,并给出具体目标(仓库、diff、PR 等)。

say.text: 用 security-research 审计当前仓库
say.note: 会拉起 5 人团队并行审计

say.text: 审计这个 PR 的 diff 有没有可利用漏洞
对发布候选版本做发布前安全检查
say.note: 产出 PASS 或 BLOCK 结论

howto.what_en: Claude spins up 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel: map attack surface, prove exploitability, classify root causes by CWE, and end with a PASS, PASS WITH FINDINGS, or BLOCK verdict report.
howto.when_en: Triggers on security review, vulnerability audit, exploitability audit and similar requests, or /security-research. Needs team-mode enabled and a concrete target such as a repo, diff, or PR.

say_en.text: Audit this PR diff for exploitable vulnerabilities
Do a pre-release security check on the release candidate
say_en.note: Ends with PASS or BLOCK verdict
